v2_implementation: GeminiLiveAdapter (future; not required or loaded in V1)

connect.effect: Create one provider connection for voice or separate text with same application session/context version.

disconnect.effect: End provider transport only; does not end application session or change local camera.

sendText.effect: Text-only connection accepts bounded typed messages; no microphone/audio capture.

updateContext.effect: Apply new backend-approved context version and accepted activity outcome; never camera state.

tool_invocation.normalized_identity: connection_id + locally stable invocation UUID; native provider ID only if exposed and tested
tool_invocation.resolution: Bridge awaits backend and UI application; handler promise then returns canonical result

camera_owner: LocalCameraPreviewController; no references, tracks, URIs or bytes passed to VoiceAgentAdapter
v2_extension: A separate future VisionCapableAdapter contract requires explicit transmission consent and capability gating; local preview permission never authorizes transmission.
